HEADLINE 1 — THE FEC DECISION STACK IS COMPUTED BUT INERT BY DEFAULT. Four controllers, one arbiter, a safety validator and a speculative lane all run on every fuzzy_evaluate, but no parity byte can reach the wire in the default product build: client-core/src/runtime.rs:199 `fec: None`, and runtime.rs:1326 `if let Some(p) = fec.as_ref() {` gates the entire block-close/latch/emit path. Independently, sender.rs:1824 defaults `fec_mode: FecActuationMode::Manual { enabled: false }` and sender.rs:4606 turns that into `zero(0, FecSuppressionReason::ManualDisabled, ..)`. So the arbiter output is, today, a diagnostic (runtime.rs:1483-1487 reads the histograms). Any claim about FEC behaviour in the product default is a claim about counters, not wire.

HEADLINE 2 — CARGO FEATURES VERIFIED DEFAULT-OFF AND NOT ENABLED BY ANY PRODUCT CRATE. `grep -rn 'experimental-fec-budget|experimental-cold-start|diag-sched-telemetry' --include=Cargo.toml .`: `experimental-fec-budget` is enabled ONLY by crates/kama-integration/Cargo.toml:29 (a test crate) and by the `udp_budget_runner` example's required-features; `experimental-cold-start` only by kama-integration:20 and kama-noise-wire/kama-engine (also test-driven); `diag-sched-telemetry` is opt-in from client-core:37 and bench:26. client-core declares no other feature. So budget_kernel (all of it), udp_runner, fs_harness and fs_trace are outside the default product build entirely (lib.rs:44,47,58 are `#[cfg(feature = "experimental-fec-budget")]`).

HEADLINE 3 — VACUOUS COUNTER (measurement-instrument trap). tail_recovery spurious-probe accounting cannot ever be non-zero in the product: the only product call site, sender.rs:5484, passes the literal `false` for the `spurious` argument. A "spurious = 0" result reported from a product-arm run is structurally guaranteed, not measured. (The kama-integration harness type crates/kama-integration/tests/common/fs_tailprobe.rs:100 has its own record_probe that DOES compute spurious — different type, different accounting.)

HEADLINE 4 — UNCONSUMED WIRE BYTES. ack.rs V2 (0x14) frames always carry `seen_count` (u32) + `arrival_rate` (u16) = 6 bytes per ACK (ack.rs:227, receiver.rs:472-477), plus `ack_epoch` (u8, always 0). None of the three has a reader: client-core/src/runtime.rs:1226-1230 constructs `AckInfo { acked_seqs, ack_delay }` and sender.rs:944-949 AckInfo has no other field. The K3 forward-vs-return loss direction split the fields were added for (ack.rs:72-77) is unimplemented.

HEADLINE 5 — THE SHIPPED CONFIG IS THE UNCALIBRATED FIXTURE, AND IT IS UNREACHABLE FOR TUNING. Sender::new (sender.rs:1766) constructs from `ValidatedFuzzyConfig::trusted_fixture()`, which bypasses `FuzzyConfig::validate()` entirely; the only validating ctor, `try_with_fuzzy_config` (sender.rs:1771), has zero product callers. The same pattern holds for RetxConfig::fixture (arq), HysteresisConfig::fixture + EmergencyConfig::fixture (emergency), SrcConfig::default (rate) and LossConfig::default (loss): all five are explicitly marked KALİBRE DEĞİL / [CAL] and none is settable from RuntimeConfig or any Sender setter. RuntimeConfig (client-core/src/runtime.rs:73-164) exposes 18 fields, none of which touch these.

PRODUCT-PATH SETTER INVENTORY (client-core/src/runtime.rs:815-880, the complete list of what the runtime configures on the engine): set_fec_structure_policy(818), set_bootstrap_rtt(823), set_cs_probe_lane(837), set_loss_confirm_horizon(840), set_fec_loss_risk(843), set_structure_gate_level(846), set_fusion_policy(851, conditional), set_initial_window(855), set_fec_actuation_mode(872, only when cfg.fec is Some), plus set_tail_recovery_config from client-core/src/lib.rs:85. Everything else in the engine runs on hard-coded fixtures.
